slovak: Pošta doručila tú zásielku o celý týždeň neskôr.
answer: The post office delivered the parcel a whole month later.

slovak: Ona nosí babkine listy v malej drevenej škatuli.
answer: She carries her grandma's letters in a small wooden box.

answer: It was snowing heavily outside since morning and the roads were slippery.

answer: If it weren't for the morning fog, the view from the top would be wonderful.

slovak: Do jari záhradník presadí všetky ruže k južnej stene.
answer: It is the gardener who will move all the roses to the south wall by spring.

slovak: Ty si mi minulý týždeň požičal ten modrý dáždnik.
answer: You loaned me that blue umbrella last week.

answer: That post office closes as early as four in the afternoon.

slovak: Hovorí sa, že v tej starej škole straší.
answer: They say that the old school is haunted.

answer: She bought a new winter coat in the city centre today.

slovak: Ja si myslím, že ona ten film ešte nevidela.
answer: Apparently she hasn't seen the film yet.

answer: On Saturday they clean the whole house, the garage and the garden.

answer: If the room weren't so loud, the guests would have a better conversation.

answer: This soup is tastier than yesterday's soup.

answer: I asked her whether she had already finished the book.

answer: It was her who our flat and two cats were looked after by all summer.

answer: It was them who recalculated the budget once more before the vote.

slovak: Náš dom stojí hneď vedľa malého parku.
answer: Our house stood right next to a small park.

answer: We watch some old film in every Friday evening.

answer: There is twenty students and two big windows in our classroom.

slovak: Tu sa nefajčí, ani na terase pred vchodom.
answer: There was no smoking here, not even on the terrace in front of the entrance.

slovak: Oni každú jar sadia pri plote nové stromčeky.
answer: Every spring they planted new little trees by the fence.
